scripts.build: vite build --mode background && vite build --mode content && vite build --mode page-script && vite build --mode popup && npm run zip
scripts.build:dev: EXT_ENV=dev vite build --mode background && EXT_ENV=dev vite build --mode content && EXT_ENV=dev vite build --mode page-script && EXT_ENV=dev vite build --mode popup
scripts.zip: npm run assert-shippable && mkdir -p ../../releases && cd build && rm -f ../../../releases/youtube-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r ../../../releases/youtube-v$npm_package_version.zip .
